name: Aves
blurb: Living birds: the descendants of feathered theropod dinosaurs that survived the end-Cretaceous extinction.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (BEAST), median and 95% HPD
clock.data: Clock-like genes for most bird families (genomic data set) with 130 fossil calibrations
clock.checked: Claramunt & Cracraft 2015, Results: genomic data set (the abstract rounds the median to 95 Ma; the RAG-1/2 data set gives 91.5 Ma, 79.8–106.8)
